description_en: A backless bench with a rectangular woven deck, three pairs of bamboo legs and a central stretcher; the front shows the uninterrupted seat and three support bays, the side exposes its slim deck and end trestle, and the rear shows the longitudinal under-seat reinforcement. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
